status: G5 first batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-debris-standard, in Chapters I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII, VIII, IX, X and XII (on the web in Chapters II, III and V only)
use: The field after a victory: a beaten force's fallen war banner beside its fallen, on the walked field.

generator.prompt: A fallen war banner lying flat on the ground: a long wooden spear shaft broken in two, with a torn and muddied rectangular cloth banner of faded red still tied to its crossbar and a dented bronze finial, lying across a split round shield; about two and a half metres long and thirty centimetres high. Weathered wood, faded red wool, bronze. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

budget.note: Height set at review from 0.3 m: its shaft came lying across the shield, raised at one end, so 0.6 m keeps the banner about 1.8 m long.

review.notes: A torn red banner on its crossbar lying flat, its shaft across it and a round shield beneath, as asked. Its shaft came raised at one end on the shield, so it was processed at 0.6 m high (not 0.3) to keep the banner about 1.8 m long.
